# Video Moment Finder

> Video Moment Finder is a SaaS tool that lets you process videos and find specific moments using semantic search. Upload a video or paste a YouTube URL, then search by text description or example image to jump straight to matching timestamps.

- Public API and CLI for indexing videos and searching them by text
- Primary documented agent flow: direct upload plus text search
- Additional product capabilities include YouTube ingestion and image-based search

## Links

- [Homepage](https://videomomentfinder.com/): Product landing page with feature overview and demo

- [Developers](https://videomomentfinder.com/developers): Human-readable API and CLI overview
- [OpenAPI Schema](https://api.videomomentfinder.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract
- [Swagger UI](https://api.videomomentfinder.com/docs): Interactive API reference

- [Support](https://videomomentfinder.com/support): FAQ and contact information
